name: kurokawa-tools-desktop
description: Kurokawa Tools for Windows, macOS and Linux — no Electron here any more: this file keeps the version the release gate reads (scripts/release-check.mjs), 7zip-bin (the Rust build bundles its 7za), ffmpeg-static (the computer ffmpeg pack, ffmpeg-pack.cjs) and webtorrent (tests/webstream.cjs, the web-stream check).
